  "explanation": "The request is interpreted as an upward reserve-sizing study for the SWPP region with a two-hour horizon (120 minutes) and a shortfall cost of 20.0, with cost_reserve=1.0. The operator explicitly requested no MW values, so no numerical reserve, cost, coverage, confidence interval, bootstrap, or dispatch outputs are generated here; all numerical outputs are produced only by the verified numerical workflow. The study schema is safe and requires human approval before use.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"

    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "SWPP",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_decision_time_safe_variable_set",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_cal_test_and_step",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "return_numerical_outputs_only_from_verified_workflow",
    "require_human_approval_before_operational_use"
  ]
}
